name: Soyuz-10
about: Soyuz-10 (1971-034A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TX), launched 1971 Apr 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 Apr 23), held fixed
docked to S05160; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
